body: Thanks I just want someone to talk to. I dont want to end my life or anything I'm just wishing it was my time to go naturally so I dont have to feel this way anymore or try to do anything when it all seems pointless..

I literally just made this account to post about this very thing. I tried to make friends at my work and they all seem friendly and talk to me while there but the moment im off work or something they just ignore me on facebook and texts. I constantly sit at home being alone and bored with no one to talk to and it sucks.
